pick.reason: The headline is the image. It reads in under two seconds at thumbnail size on both sizes, it sits fully on warm paper with one accent on "pays.", and it needs the fewest notes to reach the bar.
pick.lost: 1 the right surface panel is an empty box carrying one small line, so the split has no second element to justify it. 2 the large black fields abandon the warm paper brand, the LinkedIn headline is the smallest of the three, and the black band on ig-post is leftover space, not shaped air.
notes: ig-post: headline from about 186px to 233px (brand scale), line height 1.0, tracking -0.02em, top still at the 6% safe line (65px). Supporting line from 24px to 31px on linkedin, one line. On ig-post, set it to 39px, line height 1.3, broken after "off." into two lines. The headline-to-support jump is too steep now (standard: three sizes, one supporting size).
Mark stays at 25px in muted `#6b6a66`. Space it 32px below the supporting line on both sizes. Its baseline sits on the bottom safe line: 589px on linkedin (6%) and 1215px on ig-post (10%).
